 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The 25th-ranked Arizona Wildcats (5-1) come off a bye week on Saturday looking to keep pace with the leaders in the Big 12 Conference as they host the Iowa State Cyclones (3-3).
 Oct 9, 2026; Provo, Utah, USA; Iowa State Cyclones quarterback Jaylen Raynor (1) runs the ball during the first half against the BYU Cougars at LaVell Edwards Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Aaron Baker-Imagn Images
 How to Watch Iowa State vs Arizona
 When: Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026
 Time: 7:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: ESPN2
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Arizona last played on Oct. 10, rolling to a 52-31 win at West Virginia to improve to 2-1 in the Big 12. Noah Fifita threw for 341 yards and three touchdowns with an interception, with Isaiah Mizell catching six passes for 183 yards and two scores. Three different Wildcats scored on the ground, with Antwan Roberts Jr. putting up 63 yards and a TD on just seven carries.
 Iowa State also comes off a bye that followed a 24-10 loss at then-No. 8 BYU on Oct. 9. Christian Greenlaw scored the lone Cyclone touchdown on a one-yard pass from Jaylen Raynor, who finished 16-of-29 for 98 yards. Aiden Flora ran for 86 yards on 17 carries as Iowa State was outgained 506-200 in the loss.
 The Wildcats lead the all-time series 4-2-1 while the Cyclones won the meeting last year 39-14 at home.
 Fifita comes in with 1,756 yards and 16 touchdowns with four interceptions for Arizona, while Mizell checks in with 19 receptions for 359 yards and four scores. Kedrick Reescano leads the run game with 262 yards and four TDs. Raynor has 1,001 yards and seven touchdown passes against four picks for Iowa State, with Flora entering play with 680 rushing yards and six scores. Dominic Overby leads the receivers with 212 yards on 10 catches.
